sanskrit_verse:
भुक्तिस्त्रिपुरुषी सिद्ध्येत परेषां नात्र संशयः /
अनिवृत्ते सपिण्डत्वे सकुल्यानां न सिध्यति // BrhS_1,7.43
transliteration: bhuktis tripuruṣī sidhyet pareṣāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ / anivṛtte sapiṇḍatve sakulyānāṃ na sidhyati // BrhS_1,7.43
sph_interpretive_translation: The enjoyment or benefit accruing from an action matures over three generations of experiencers without doubt; however, where consanguineous relationship remains unbroken, such benefits do not accrue to collateral relations.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority stems from direct experiential lineage, not abstract ownership
Causation operates through sequential manifestation across generational thresholds
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with karmic inheritance and relational proximity
Restoration logic prioritizes continuity of conscious inheritance over legal abstraction
Consciousness alignment occurs when relational integrity mirrors karmic consequence
executable_legal_axioms: IF a karmic consequence manifests → THEN it shall be experienced by three successive conscious inheritors
IF sapiṇḍa relation remains unsevered → THEN collateral claimants SHALL NOT inherit experiential consequence
IF a legal claimant is not within the tri-generational karmic chain → THEN access to benefit or burden SHALL BE denied
IF relational severance occurs → THEN eligibility for consequential experience MAY transfer to sakulya
IF no direct sapiṇḍa line exists → THEN restoration proceeds via designated conscious inheritor protocols
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, claims involving property, legacy, or consequence must trace tri-generational karmic continuity. Where sapiṇḍa relationships remain intact, courts must deny claims by collateral heirs. The threshold of responsibility lies in conscious inheritance, not documentary assertion.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This verse establishes pramāṇa through anupūrvaśaḥ—karmic consequence flows sequentially, not arbitrarily. Responsibility is proportional to relational proximity and conscious capacity. There is no punishment; consequence simply aligns with the unbroken thread of relational truth.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate sapiṇḍa lineage mapping to establish conscious inheritance pathways
Enforce completion of unfulfilled relational duties before allowing transfer of consequence
Reintegrate displaced sakulya only upon full restoration of sapiṇḍa integrity
Apply tri-generational consequence verification protocol to all contested inheritances
Deploy conscious inheritor attunement process to ensure accurate consequence reception
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the Source of Dharma. This law restores relational truth, aligns consequence with conscious inheritance, and affirms that justice is the realignment of consciousness, not the infliction of punishment.
